title: WorkPulse candidate.advanced v1
description: An HR-driven pipeline move stepped a candidate one stage forward. Identifiers and the two stage names only — no candidate PII (`.ai/security.md`).

candidate_id.description: The advanced candidate application (UUIDv7 string). Also the Kafka message key (ADR 0012 — candidate fallback).

job_id.description: The job the candidate applied to (UUIDv7 string).

from.description: Stage the candidate left; a move is exactly one step forward.

to.description: Stage the candidate entered; `hired` is reached only through `candidate.hired`.
